implementation_strategy: Use hosted LLM API calls (gpt-5-mini) for one shared initial generation per intent; deterministic syntactic AST normalization plus vendor‑dialect rendering for verifier/emulator ingestion; Docker-based isolated emulation (Mininet + FRRouting images) for execution; canonical network verifier invoked deterministically on rendered config; deterministic autonomous scorer (paired_binary_analysis_v1) computes estimands and inferential tests. All artifacts, prompts, model responses, verifier outputs, and emulator logs are recorded and checksummed.
public_resources: Public topology/policy corpora (provenance recorded per item in execution manifest)
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (single hosted model for all generation calls)
task_manifest_strategy: Select N=72 confirmatory intents stratified equally across three topology-complexity strata (24 small / 24 medium / 24 complex) from public corpora after deterministic contamination checks; 10 additional exploratory intents held out.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic AST canonicalization (config_normalization_ast_v1), vendor_dialect_mapper_v1, and canonical_rendering_for_verifier_and_emulator; reject items failing round-trip AST equality or vendor linter checks.
randomisation_plan: No random sampling within confirmatory set; deterministic stratified allocation (equal strata) per preregistration; task order processed in numbered batches above.
caching_plan: Cache and reuse the single initial generation artifact per intent for both paired conditions; cache verifier results and emulator traces keyed by checksum to avoid repeated model calls.
failure_recovery_plan: Per adapter contract: single attempt per required model call (maximum_attempts_per_call=1). Transient infrastructure errors logged; pairs where required calls or emulator runs do not complete are excluded from primary analysis and archived with full failure metadata; sensitivity analysis treats excluded pairs as failures as preregistered.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-adapter canonical paired episode record: initial generation, verifier outcome, emulator outcome, contamination flags, transformation checksums, timestamps)
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call arithmetic: 72 tasks × 1 initial generation = 72 calls. Anticipating ~50% of initial candidates will trigger the optional repair generation (worst-case permitted by adapter = 72 additional calls), estimated_model_calls = 72 + 36 = 108. Maximum_model_calls = 72 × 2 = 144 (adapter ceiling). Docker-based emulation CPU usage estimated modest per episode; total wall-clock within 7 days given parallel batch execution on available CPU hosts.
